tagline.id: Mesin uji dengan dua motor stepper untuk uji patah spesimen kecil (maks. 30×50×50 mm).
tagline.en: A dual-stepper test machine for fracture testing of small specimens (max 30×50×50 mm).

approach.id: Dua motor NEMA 23 dengan planetary gear menggerakkan crosshead lewat lead screw. Beban dibaca load cell S-type 500 kg lewat ESP32 dan PCB custom, semuanya di rangka profil aluminium 2040.
approach.en: Two NEMA 23 motors with planetary gears drive the crosshead through lead screws. Load is read by a 500 kg S-type load cell through an ESP32 and a custom PCB, all on a 2040 aluminium profile frame.
